decisions.decision: TokenDeltaDropOldestChannel<Tag> per-element drop policy: drops oldest matching dropTag, suspends on others
decisions.rationale: AGENT-10 invariant — high-frequency tokenDelta must not block toolCall delivery. Load test 10000+1000 @ cap=2048 → exactly 1000 toolCall delivered, ≤2048 tokenDelta retained.
Crash-tolerant durability without per-event fsync penalty; turn-boundary-only checkpoint matches OBS-02 batching semantics
